name: copy-content-with-tree
description: Copy selected files/folders content with a path tree for AI context, plus Copy Tree and Copy Git Diff with Tree.
author: Xiao Yao

virtualWorkspaces.description: This extension reads local files and runs Git on the filesystem.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Copy Content and Copy Tree work in untrusted workspaces using the filesystem and nested .gitignore rules only (no Git). Copy Git Diff requires workspace trust because it runs Git.

scripts.test:electron: npm run build && npm run build:test-electron && node scripts/run-vscode-test.mjs
scripts.test:electron:min: npm run build && npm run build:test-electron && VSCODE_TEST_VERSION=1.80.0 node scripts/run-vscode-test.mjs
scripts.test:electron:stable: npm run build && npm run build:test-electron && VSCODE_TEST_VERSION=stable node scripts/run-vscode-test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit && npm run package && node scripts/check-vsix.mjs && npm run test:electron:stable

commands.title: Copy Content with Tree: Debug Selection

copyContentWithTree.exclude.description: Exclude patterns merged with built-in excludes when copying folders. Plain names match full path segments only; globs use micromatch.

copyContentWithTree.blacklist.description: Additional exclude patterns merged with built-in excludes and copyContentWithTree.exclude.

copyContentWithTree.useGitignore.description: Respect .gitignore. In Git repositories, Git is the source of truth for tracked/ignored files. Outside Git, nested .gitignore files are applied while walking.

copyContentWithTree.gitignoreFileName.description: Gitignore file name to read when walking non-Git trees or filtering untracked diff paths.

copyContentWithTree.maxFileSizeKB.description: Skip files larger than this size in KB when copying content.

copyContentWithTree.maxOutputChars.description: Abort before writing to the clipboard if the generated output exceeds this many characters. Set 0 to disable.

copyContentWithTree.includeSkippedInTree.description: Whether skipped binary/large/unreadable/ignored files should still appear in the tree with a skip comment.

copyContentWithTree.diffAutoFetch.description: Run git fetch --prune before copying Git diff against the selected branch upstream. Disabled by default.

copyContentWithTree.diffIncludeUntracked.description: Include untracked files in Copy Git Diff with Tree by appending them as new-file patches.

copyContentWithTree.diffUnifiedLines.description: Number of unchanged context lines to include in Copy Git Diff with Tree patches. Set 3 for normal git diff context.

copyContentWithTree.followFileSymlinks.description: Copy file symlink target content while keeping the symlink path in headers. Targets outside the workspace/selection boundary are refused unless allowExternalSymlinkTargets is enabled. Directory symlinks are never traversed.

copyContentWithTree.allowExternalSymlink.description: Allow following file symlink targets that resolve outside the workspace or selection boundary. Disabled by default for safety.

copyContentWithTree.pathRewrite.description: Optional absolute-path rewrite rules for symlink targets (for example container vs host mounts). Default is empty; do not put private host paths in shared settings.

copyContentWithTree.gitTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each Git subprocess.

copyContentWithTree.gitMaxBufferBytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes retained from each Git subprocess.
